title: Provides editable suggestions for text input
goal: Bind the datalist to the text input box, retaining custom input capabilities.
summary: Most applications come from three commonly used academic buildings. Add candidate values ​​to facilitate selection, and also allow other buildings to be filled in.
tasks: creates a datalist with the ID building-options and adds three options with the values ​​ "Duxing Building" "Mingde Building" "Qiuzhi Building".

example.note: list points to the ID of datalist. Compared with select, the input box still allows filling in values ​​other than candidates.

hint: It is recommended that the value is written in the value attribute of option, and the type of input is still text.
